core: Retry privileged binds on EACCES instead of checking port < 1024 (#8253)

WithBindCapability assumed the kernel's privileged port range ends at
1024, but it is set by net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port_start, which can
be anywhere from 0 (Docker's default) to 65535. With a value above
1024, a non-root bind to e.g. :1500 failed even though the capability
was permitted.

Now listen is called normally first, and only if it fails with EACCES
on a TCP/UDP port, and CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE is permitted but not
effective, the capability is raised and the bind retried. This also
skips raising it when the range starts lower than the port.
